name: agentmon-live
description: AgentMon Live: see what every Codex chat is doing, live in your browser: turns, tool calls, checks, files, context and limits

interface.shortDescription: See what every chat is doing, live
interface.longDescription: Starts AgentMon Live's web view with each Codex session. The page at http://127.0.0.1:47311/ lists every Codex chat on this machine: turns with their time split, tool calls, test and build results, files, context and limits.
